body:
_Migrated from issue #1182, filed 2026-07-27._

Split out of #1180.

`e2e/sp1-ux.spec.ts:3` ("Library navigation hierarchy and search are coherent") fails and then passes on retry. Playwright reports it as `flaky`, not `failed`.

The failing assertion is the nav ordering:

```
customizeBox.y > aboutBox.y   →   Received: false
```

Seen on `release/v4.1.22-recut` (passed on retry #1) and on #1178 (reported flaky in the run totals).

It is **not** what made the e2e gate red repo-wide — that was the magic-link fixture gap fixed in #1180. Filing separately so it does not get lost behind that.

Do not quarantine it. The assertion covers real nav structure; a flaky true assertion is worth more than a deleted one. Most likely a race between measuring `boundingBox()` and the nav finishing layout/animation, so the fix is probably an explicit wait on a stable state rather than a change to the expectation.
title: sp1-ux.spec.ts:3 is flaky (nav ordering assertion)
